title: Ultra-Euclidean functions: such rings need not be fields or polynomial rings
summary: A ring with an ultra-Euclidean function need not be a field or K[x].
source: S. Sekhon, "A Necessary and Sufficient Condition for Uniqueness of Euclidean Division", arXiv:2604.24399v2 (April 2026), section "Further investigation".
label: lean
